items.title: Cutting a smooth morphism by a Cartier divisor at a point with separable residue extension
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a morphism smooth at a point whose residue field extension is separable and whose point is not generic in its fibre, the lemma produces an affine neighbourhood and an effective Cartier divisor through the point such that the divisor is smooth over the base. The proof uses separability to find a parameter whose differentials behave well, cuts by that parameter, and verifies smoothness of the slice using the differential criterion. Producing a divisor whose structure map is smooth, rather than merely flat, is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 10746-10767.
